name: Transient Nonlinear Beam Radiance Estimation
definition: An extension of steady-state beam estimation to include time-dependent light transport by reconstructing emission signals using time-of-flight (TOF) data stored in the photon map.
summary: Transient Nonlinear Beam Radiance Estimation reconstructs time-dependent light transport by reusing spatial photon distributions with time-of-flight data, avoiding the high photon counts of naive 4D photon mapping.
